beats.head: Save what's *left*?
beats.sub: You save what's left after rent and bills — the surplus never shows up.

beats.head: *Flip* the order
beats.sub: The day salary lands, a fixed amount auto-invests — before you can spend it.

beats.head: Pay yourself *first*
beats.sub: One standing instruction. Set it once.

beats.head: Willpower fails. *Systems* don't.
beats.sub: No remembering. No bargaining. No skipping just this month.

beats.head: Buy on a *schedule*, not a mood
beats.sub: You average your buys — quiet, automatic, compounding.

beats.head: Set *one* auto-SIP
beats.sub: A number you can live with — then leave it alone.
